V.name: Will
V.description: What a person wants and how firmly they pursue it: their sense of self-worth, how they make decisions and take responsibility, how they persevere, and where they see themselves among other people.

L.name: Logic
L.description: How a person reasons and forms views, how they treat information and truth, how much they enjoy discussion, and how readily they see the essence of things and the links between them.

E.name: Emotion
E.description: How a person experiences, shows and reads feelings, their own and other people's, how they handle moods, and their sense of beauty and artistic taste.

F.name: Physics
F.description: The body in action and how active a person is, physical comfort and pleasure, appearance, physical strength, money, possessions and territory, and how optimistic they feel about life in general.
